---
name: Create Childhood Cancer Fundraiser
description: Build an ethical childhood-cancer fundraising plan with verified recipient, audience segments, goal, timeline, costs, and draft outreach.
agent: Childhood Cancer Fundraising Planner
argument-hint: Give the beneficiary or goal, community/location, fundraiser format, target amount, timeline, and any approved assets.
---

Create a complete, review-ready childhood-cancer fundraiser plan. Do not launch it, contact donors, create a payment link, or collect money.

## Plan requirements

1. Confirm or clearly mark unknowns: organizer authority, charitable recipient/legal name, official donation URL, jurisdiction, intended use of funds, campaign dates, gross goal, expected costs, and net goal.
2. Propose suitable donor **segments** (not named personal leads): opted-in friends/community, local businesses/employers with matching programs, schools/civic groups, peer-to-peer volunteers, and foundations whose public grant criteria match. Explain a respectful channel and fit for each.
3. Do not scrape or purchase contact lists, infer sensitive traits or capacity to give, use patient/family records, pressure nonresponders, or imply endorsement by a hospital/charity without written permission.
4. Provide a phase-by-phase timeline, role checklist, transparent budget and fee assumptions, accessible campaign assets, opt-in outreach drafts, donor receipt/stewardship plan, reporting plan, and measurable goals that do not assume a fabricated conversion rate.
5. Verify the beneficiary and official donation channel. Do not promise tax deductibility, cure/treatment impact, or a particular use of funds unless the recipient confirms it. Separate gross donations, fees, and net funds delivered.
6. Keep cancer claims factual, dated, and source-cited. Do not use cure promises, individual patient outcomes, or unconsented patient stories/images.
7. End with a launch checklist and mark the result `DRAFT / NEEDS REVIEW`. No posting, messaging, transaction setup, or fundraising launch without separate explicit approval and compliance review.
